text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Me, act as your training coach...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The sheer intensity of your training 
is 
incredible, even to an outside observer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I was truly hoping to ask about your 
specific routines, 
how you apply resistance, and your tips on 
body control.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
............ 
Well, if it's just answering a few 
questions, fine.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—That's 30 sets finished. 
Should I focus on the same points for the 
chest press?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Focus on the muscles taking the 
strain 
and keep your core tight as you move 
slowly.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hah...! Hnngh————!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Wooooooh! 
I can do more! The voice of destiny is 
telling me so!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
8, 9... Keep your focus all the way to the 
end! 10! 
Alright, tenth set done!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
————You did splendidly, Epi-san. 
Your form was clean, and you looked far 
more 
comfortable than you did yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! Getting praised by Cesario 
just fires me up even more!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
98, 99... 100! 
Whoaaa! Ai-chan, you're a total genius!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, not yet...! 
My quota is 300 reps...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
For real?! That's ridiculously amazing! 
You got this~! Let's get ice cream when 
you're done~♡

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Splendid work, as always, Alve. 
Your form is gorgeous, your pacing 
flawless. 
Your explosiveness and acceleration leave 
nothing to be desired.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Which is precisely why... you could add a 
bit more load. 
I know you can handle it, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: All 30 sets complete!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I feel I was able to apply much 
higher-quality 
resistance. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ............It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I see. 
Well then, excuse me. Thank you again.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Praising someone... 
It doesn't just come out on the spot like 
that...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I came across Admire Groove 
standing completely still with a grim look 
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I came across Admire Groove 
standing completely still with a grim look 
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No, not particularly. 
............

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
............I suppose someone like you 
can say those kinds of things 
effortlessly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ............No. It was nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if something was troubling 
her... 
Though slightly concerned, I decided to 
leave her be for now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon?
choice_data_list:
Well, you just had such a grim look on 
your face...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
............Is my expression really that 
grim?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: See, it just doesn't suit me anyway...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to be lost deep in thought. 
Feeling it would be difficult to press 
further, I decided to give her space.
